name: Psyllium husk
short: Case reports: blockage of the gullet or bowel, with a warning about taking it without adequate fluid, and severe allergic reactions (anaphylaxis) in sensitised people.
text: Case reports describe blockage of the oesophagus by a mass of psyllium husk powder in a 76-year-old man with Parkinson's disease, and intestinal obstruction after eating psyllium-containing food; the authors of the latter warned that obstruction may occur if psyllium is taken without adequate fluid intake. Case reports also describe severe allergic reactions, including anaphylaxis, after swallowing psyllium in people already sensitised to it, with health professionals and laxative-manufacturing workers who handle it at greatest risk. No interaction data were found in the cited sources.
